data.title: Added To Wardrobe

selected_item.promptDescription: This garment is a sleeveless dress with a V-neckline. The bodice features a draped, ruched design with overlapping fabric panels creating an asymmetrical cross-over detail at the waist. The shoulder straps are absent, and the upper edge of the bodice forms a V-shape. The waistline transitions into a gathered, pleated skirt that flows continuously from the bodice without visible seams separating the two sections. The skirt has a voluminous, A-line silhouette with cascading pleats extending from the waist. The hemline is not fully visible, but the skirt appears to be floor-length or long. The fabric has a smooth texture with visible draping and gathering, and there are no visible closures, trims, or embellishments on the front of the dress. The overall construction is a single, continuous piece with a fitted bodice that flares into a full skirt
